source: Star Fox EX user-supplied ROM radio tables

messages.en: i guess i should be thankful###
you can run, but you can't hide!
make the neck and tail shorter, fox!!
shoot down its arms to hit its body!
i got one! i got one!!
please make the neck and tail shorter, fox!
shoot down its arms to hit its body!
pick me up on your way back!
ribbit! i'll bring up the rear,fox!
i can't tell which is real!!
be a bit more careful fox!
i don't think i'm going to make it!
star fox team, our last resort is to counter attack venom!  good luck!
andross's forces intend to build a base in this area!  destroy their rock crusher!
the space armada consists of powerful battleships! destroy their energy cores!
be sure to use your retros if you're going too fast!  be careful with my arwings!
andross is hiding on venom!  fox, you must find his core brain and destroy it!
corneria's resource world has been overrun!  you must re-take the weather control unit!
how are the arwings handling?  if an amoeba clings to your ship, use l or r to get rid of it#
you've chosen course three###  a good choice to take venom by surprise!
use the l or r button to escape the tractor beam of the enemy battleship! you can do it, fox!
andross has taken control of the huge creatures who live on fortuna!  take care, fox!
your team is doing well, fox!  i hope you're taking good care of my arwings!  go for macbeth!
the hollow interior of macbeth is ideal for a base!  prevent andross from building here!
this space grave yard, created by andross's experiments, is where your father vanished, fox!
is everyone all right, fox?!  you're on course to sneak into venom's back door!
come in, arwings!  fox, where are you?!  we need you to protect corneria!
you've made it this far### it's your fate to destroy andross!  we're counting on you, fox!
ahhh### you are quite skillful,   fox!
ok, you passed! go fight the real enemy!
hit start to   go back to the game, ribbit!
i'm sorry         i doubted you! press start!
fox,           you are indeed a worthy foe###
but, your foolish efforts are futile!
your arwings have no chance against me!
i thought you might make it eventually###
general pepper has guided you well!
however, you will not escape here alive!
ah## your choice of routes took me by surprise!
your father was a reckless fighter too###
but this will be the mccloud's last battle!
what's wrong with you today, fox?!
oh## you took the scenic route!
your father only liked planets too###
this course isn't anywhere in our records###  good luck, fox!
all of the bosses are coming at you! be careful, fox!
you've made it this far###  keep going!
they just won't stop coming! can you finish them off?
all that's left is to take out andross himself# you can do it, fox!
aha! i feel so powerful now! die, fox!
it's about time you showed up, fox! corneria is under attack!
it's an all out marine assault! stop them from getting to our military base!
this zone has not been explored yet# be careful, fox!
our intel has heard whispers of a psychological weapon hidden in this sector# destroy it!
looks like this planet is where these enemies are coming from# please, come back in one piece!
fox, this planet does not have any breathable air# please stay in those arwings!
don't be fooled by this planet's green fields, its inhabitants are known to be hostile!
this planet is home to some kind of psychic, or###sorcerer? please, put a stop to his antics!
the moon base of gekou has been overrun# destroy the enemies and free the base!
fox, your home planet is under attack! hurry and stop their mothership!
this arctic planet has the first signs of life in a long time# destroy anything hostile!
kuraudo has no solid ground, and is covered in gaseous clouds# fly carefully, fox!
can't let you do that, star fox!
too bad dad's not here to see ya fail!
let's see how you handle our ships!
we'll make sure you never reach andross!
don't get too cocky, star fox!
we'll just see about that star wolf#
no way! i don't believe it!
you can't beat me! i've got a better ship!
not yet# the party's just begun!
give it up# you can't win!
i see it up ahead# let's rock and roll!
soon, you're-a gonna be playin' with power###!
it's time for us to feed you###
we're about to give you a burial at sea!
or, uh, in space# have at you!
fox, my sensors are off the charts!
i'm detecting a powerful object ahead!
careful! there's lots of meteors ahead!
don't get too cocky here! meteors ahead!
just another easy paycheck, right fox?
one day i'm gonna be too old for this###
who do you think is doing all of this?
whoever is behind all this is toast!
why do we do this? money? glory? money#
its the dark side of the moon!
it feels like we could float away here###
feels like a trap, eyes forward!
i've got a bad feeling about this, fox###
you may have to do some barrel rolls!
get these things off of us, ribbit!
my ship is all slimy now, guys!
the sky is so nice here, ribbit!
remember, we aren't on vacation, fox!
i could really retire around here###
something really strong is close by###
let's push through! almost at the end!
fox, you are so much like your father###
fox, try to save some for us this time!
what did you get me into this time, fox?
fox? where did you go? you left your teammates behind? make contact quick and help them!
blue yoshi mode, heal and defend!
think you can fly between the trees, fox?
don't try to fly between those trees, fox!
is anyone else getting that feeling?
i can feel the electricity in the air!
don't fly too l-l-low, you'll hit rocks!
now's not the time for sightseeing, fox!
i always love some target practice!
don't go showing off now, stay focused!
this is it, ribbit! let's g-g-go!
time to collect that paycheck, lets go!
this is our final job, rock and roll!
i'm g-g-getting some high energy readings!
whatever is up ahead, its really strong!
we'll have to be tactical ahead, fox!
come on fox! i've been p-p-practicing!
i hope we find a real challenge this time!
i've n-n-never seen corneria like this!
this planet sure is full of life###
i wonder what we'll find around here#
i'm just starting to warm up!
d-d-did you hear that noise ahead?
hey, are we heading the right way?
my radar is all jammed up!
i hope our ships hold up in this ice!
the heat is off the charts ahead!
that cloud looks like a f-f-frog!
keep your head out of the clouds!
oh my, that is really bright!
that cloud looks like you, fox!
let's go! i g-g-got your back!
lets finish this and get paid!
i hope t-t-this is the end###
this is it! one last job!
i'm glad i replaced my wipers!
fox, w-w-where are you?? we need backup!
hey! i got your signal but i can't see you!
fox, we finished the core, where are you?
i s-s-see you on our radar! on the way, fox!
fox, don't worry about us, we can handle this#
we have your position# follow our beacon!
gee# it's the famous star fox!
this time, i'm going to handle things#
no more being a sidekick for me#
well, this isn't t-t-too bad so far###
now this is my kind of place!
i better not get my feathers wet!
remember, our ships can't go under!
you may think the galaxy is safe###
but you've only just scratched the surface!
explore the cosmos all you like###
control type a or c are recommended!
use l and r to pivot your ship#
tap l or r twice to barrel roll!
remember to tilt your ship to move faster!
barrel rolls are also essential to surviving!
now go on and protect the galaxy!
all who see my rose meet death!
you won't stop me that easily!
how could this be?!? i-i've been###
wooow# what are all those heads?
it's time to bomb some dodongos!
you're heading in the right direction#
the rusted chains of prison moons###
i walk a road, horizons change###
doing this moves your ship faster!
what happened here? this is awful!
why would they do all of this?!
someone's gotta pay for all this###
###hey, how do you steer this thing!?
we have to be really careful!
we should approach with caution, fox#
this place seems to just repeat###
we should reset to get out of here!
who's making all this noise up here?!
you're not going any further, punk!
stop what you're doing right now!
i'd like to see you try###
heh, you're not as weak as i thought!
argh! i'm not done with you yet!
doing this blocks most enemy attacks!
banking is important too! hold l or r###
to move faster in that direction!
you are on mister or analogue pocket! cool!
this is snes9x based - overclock it!
wait, this thing runs on zsnes? sorta###
you are on canoe, nintendo's official emu!
this is an sd2snes or fxpak! hardware rocks!
this appears to be bsnes plus# overclock everything!
this device is an analogue super nt! cool!
